targets.rawSql: SELECT composite_score AS "Score" FROM indexer_snapshots WHERE snapshot_at = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_at) FROM indexer_snapshots) AND composite_score IS NOT NULL

SELECT i.name AS "Indexer", s.composite_score AS "Score", s.score_grade AS "Grade", ROUND(s.self_stake::numeric, 0) AS "Self Stake", ROUND(s.delegated_tokens::numeric, 0) AS "Delegated" FROM indexer_snapshots s JOIN indexers i ON i.address = s.indexer_address WHERE s.snapshot_at = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_at) FROM indexer_snapshots) AND s.composite_score IS NOT NULL ORDER BY s.composite_score DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT snapshot_at AS time, ROUND(AVG(composite_score)::numeric, 1) AS "Avg Score", ROUND(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY composite_score)::numeric, 1) AS "Median Score" FROM indexer_snapshots WHERE composite_score IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(snapshot_at) GROUP BY snapshot_at ORDER BY snapshot_at

SELECT DATE_TRUNC('day', snapshot_at) AS time, ROUND(SUM(self_stake)::numeric, 0) AS "Total Self Stake", ROUND(SUM(delegated_tokens)::numeric, 0) AS "Total Delegated" FROM indexer_snapshots WHERE $__timeFilter(snapshot_at) GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('day', snapshot_at) ORDER BY time

SELECT DATE_TRUNC('day', timestamp) AS time, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE event_type = 'delegation') AS "Delegations", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE event_type = 'undelegation') AS "Undelegations" FROM delegation_events WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('day', timestamp) ORDER BY time
